info.description: CIRS Lab5. Fictional local data only. Start the assembled API, then run requests in order. Repeated runs use fresh generated email values. No authentication or production presence is implemented.

item.name: 01 GET current incidents for expected counts

exec: const active = pm.response.json().filter(x => !['CLOSED', 'REJECTED'].includes(x.status)); pm.collectionVariables.set('expectedActive', active.length); pm.collectionVariables.set('expectedCritical', active.filter(x => x.priority === 'CRITICAL').length);

pm.test('Counts agree with the incident data', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.activeIncidents).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('expectedActive'))); pm.expect(b.criticalAlerts).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('expectedCritical'))); });

pm.test('Operational API and fictional presence fixture', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.system).to.eql('Cyber Incident Reporting System'); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('Operational'); pm.expect(b.onlineAnalysts).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.systemUptime).to.be.at.least(0); });
